items.title: Ja'Kobi Lane: On track to be activated from IR
items.text:
Lane (wrist) is "good to go" after practicing fully this week and is expected to be activated from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game against the Browns, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt: Not spotted at Saturday's practice
items.text:
Croskey-Merritt (groin) wasn't at Saturday's practice and will not likely be available for Monday night's game against the 49ers, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

items.title: Jalen Hurts: IR stint not expected
items.text:
Hurts remains sidelined indefinitely due to a superficial blood clot in his calf, but the Eagles are not planning to place the Philadelphia quarterback on injured reserve, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
